title: Mnesis Canonical Episode Manifest
description: Schema for episode manifest.json sidecars (SPEC §Episode layout).

episodeIndex.description: 0-based episode index matching the first frame's episode_index.

frameCount.description: Number of frames in the episode data.jsonl.

jsonlSizeBytes.description: Byte size of the data.jsonl file on disk.

videoPath.description: Relative path to the video sidecar, or null if absent.

videoSizeBytes.description: Byte size of the video file (0 if no video).

eventsPath.description: Relative path to the events.jsonl sidecar, or null if absent.

annotationsPath.description: Relative path to the annotations/spans.jsonl sidecar, or null if absent.

clock.description: Cross-device clock synchronization metadata (C6). Present when the capture surface can measure its clock offset against a reference clock.

source.description: Time-synchronisation source: ptp (Precision Time Protocol), tsf (Wi-Fi TSF), ntp (NTP), or none (no synchronisation).

refDeviceId.description: Device id of the reference clock in a multi-device session. Omitted when source is 'none'.

offsetNs.description: Signed clock offset of this device relative to the reference clock, in nanoseconds. Positive means this device's clock is ahead of the reference.

estErrorNs.description: Estimated uncertainty of offsetNs in nanoseconds. Non-negative. Downstream consumers use this to decide whether the data is fusible.
